SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Location, Position and Size of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Location, Position and Size of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Location, Position and Size of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Location, Position and Size of Kenya.
   D. Treat Location, Position and Size of Kenya as rumours only.

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

3. Which statement about Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage.
   C. Say Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites as rumours only.
   B. Explain Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites.
   D. Say Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Mining in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Mining in Kenya.
   B. Say Mining in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Mining in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Mining in Kenya as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Population distribution in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Population distribution in Kenya as rumours only.
   B. Explain Population distribution in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Population distribution in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Population distribution in Kenya.

7. Which statement about The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui as rumours only.
   C. Say The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui.

8. Which statement about African Traditional Education is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing African Traditional Education.
   B. Explain African Traditional Education with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat African Traditional Education as rumours only.
   D. Say African Traditional Education never happens in Kenya.

9. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Mombasa
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

10. Which statement about Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi.
   B. Treat Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi as rumours only.
   C. Say Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about School administration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain School administration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing School administration.
   C. Treat School administration as rumours only.
   D. Say School administration never happens in Kenya.

12. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Name the president
   D. Measure rainfall only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Population distribution in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain African Traditional Education and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain School administration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Mining in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
